Sets the title of the program window.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
AppTitle "My game"
```
@param title         The window title.
@param close_prompt  The question the original asked before closing the window.
@gap It works before or after [Graphics](Graphics) alike: a title set before the window exists names the window when it is made, and one set later renames it. Until a program sets a title, the window is called `BlitzLLVM`. The question is asked when somebody closes the window. If they cancel, the program carries on; otherwise the window closes as it would have without the question.
